name: AAP TLS certificate rotation
description: Unsupported content. Rotating platform certificates restarts Ansible Automation Platform services. Launch this from a management cluster, never from the platform being rotated.

spec.question_description: How the target Ansible Automation Platform was installed.
custom uses certificate material from the project or a credential. regenerate has the installation program create new self-signed certificates and is not valid for operator-based installations.
Operator-based installations support automation controller and automation hub only.
spec.choices:
gateway
controller
hub
eda
postgresql
receptor

spec.question_name: I accept that the platform will be restarted and unavailable
spec.question_description: The installation program restarts every service. Running jobs on the target platform are interrupted. Select true only inside an approved change window.

spec.question_name: This job is NOT rotating the platform running it
spec.question_description: Confirm the target is a different Ansible Automation Platform cluster than the one executing this job.
false stages the certificates and edits the inventory file without applying anything - a dry run for a change-window handoff.
Directory on the target host holding the installation program and its inventory file. Container-based and RPM-based only.
